title: Executive Administrative Assistant
description:
About the Role


This is not a typical virtual assistant position. We're looking for an AI-forward Executive Assistant with a Chief-of-Staff potential in the future who builds systems, owns outcomes, and drives the week to zero open tabs and inbox zero.

You'll work directly with Billie Graham , a strategic leader managing multiple high-growth ventures across commercial construction, lead generation, nonprofit leadership, property management, and family. Billie is based in Charlotte, NC, and needs someone who can anticipate needs, convert ambiguity into calendar blocks and checklists, and relentlessly close loops.

The Goal: Expand capacity and increase velocity of execution through systems, AI automation, and proactive operational support.

This role offers rare exposure to diverse industries while building the foundational processes that will enable rapid scaling. You'll be part of the early team, collaboratively identifying tools and systems needed to achieve great outcomes.

About Billie's Ventures


All ventures are in growth mode, and most do not have formal processes yet. You'll solve for and document processes to allow rapid onboarding of future hires with repeatable results.

  • Myers & Chapman – Strategic Markets Leader for Healthcare and Public Projects at this Commercial General Contractor
  • Leads Exchange Group – Industry networking agency launching a new high-ticket service offering in 2025
  • ReGroup Carolinas – Board Member for this nonprofit focused on workforce development in construction trades
  • Rental Property – Management of two rental units


Who We're Looking For


We need a systems-thinker with high agency who is AI-native, proactive, and relentlessly follows through. You should be comfortable with ambiguity, able to convert loose ideas into structured action plans, and driven to improve workflows weekly.

Critical mindset: We're looking for critical thinking over "task-taker." You should anticipate needs, propose solutions, and own outcomes—not just execute orders.

Personality Traits of Successful Candidates:
  • Proactive and calm under pressure
  • Highly organized and goal-oriented
  • Systems-first thinker with high agency
  • Pushes for clarity and closes loops consistently
  • Low-ego, coachable, rigorous about details and data
  • Comfortable saying "no/next" to protect priorities
Operational Cadence & Responsibilities
Weekly Rhythm:

Calendar & Commitments:

  • Own and manage family/school/kids' activities, professional meetings, travel, and reservations
  • Send Friday Weekly Brief : next week at a glance, risks flagged, top 3 priorities identified

Inbox & Communications:

  • Triage emails and meeting invites daily
  • File receipts and manage reimbursements
  • Maintain stakeholder communication loops

Task System:

  • Maintain running capture board across all ventures
  • Convert texts/voice notes → tasks with deadlines
  • Confirm task owner and status; nudge until done

Research & Automation:

  • Conduct project research and generate executive summaries
  • Web scraping and competitive tracking
  • Automate report generation and research tasks
  • Contact enrichment and CRM logging
  • Public records, permits, budgets research

SOP Engine:

  • Record Looms of recurring tasks
  • Ship 1+ SOP per week to the vault
  • Document processes to enable future team scaling
  • Iterate and refine edge cases

Family/Personal Operations:

  • Manage school communications and kids' calendars
  • Coordinate family travel and summer camp planning
  • Handle household-related administrative tasks

AI & Systems Improvement:

  • Propose workflow automation improvements weekly
  • Implement AI tools to increase efficiency
  • Build and optimize capture → triage → plan → execute systems
  • Raise quality bars continuously
Required Skills & Experience
Must-Have:


  • 1–2 years minimum executive assistant or operations experience
  • Advanced AI literacy : Fluent with ChatGPT, Copilot, and Perplexity; strong prompt crafting abilities
  • Calendar triage & stakeholder management : Expert-level scheduling and communication coordination
  • Research skills : Public records, permits, budgets, market intelligence
  • SOP creation : Ability to document processes via Loom-to-SOP workflow
  • Excel/Power BI basics : Structured data work and simple reporting
  • Clear written English : Concise, action-oriented communication style
  • Security hygiene : Understanding of role-based access and data protection
  • Documentation discipline : Rigorous attention to detail
  • Strong interest in AI use cases and implementation
Nice-to-Have:


  • Basic Python or no-code automation experience (Zapier, Make, n8n)
  • AEC (Architecture/Engineering/Construction) familiarity: Procore, RFQ/RFP exposure
  • Web scraping capabilities
  • HubSpot or CRM management experience
  • Contact enrichment skills (LinkedIn, research tools)
  • Power BI visualization and dashboard creation
  • Golf handicap lookup experience (when relevant for relationship building)
Tools & Platforms You'll Use


  • Email/SMS (Google & Microsoft suites)
  • Ninety.io (project/goal management)
  • ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity (AI tools – critical)
  • Slack, Discord, Telegram (team communication)
  • SharePoint, Google Workspace, MS Teams (document management)
  • Excel (data organization)
  • Additional tools to be collaboratively identified
What We Offer


  • Compensation: Starting at $1,100 USD per month
  • Full-time position: 40 hours per week
  • Consistent schedule: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST, Monday–Friday
  • Fully remote: Work from anywhere
  • Direct collaboration with an entrepreneurial leader
  • Exposure to multiple industries: Construction, lead generation, nonprofit, real estate
  • Ground-floor opportunity: Help build foundational systems for scaling ventures
  • Learning environment: Strong focus on AI implementation and automation
Company Culture & Values


Culture in one line: We are problem solvers—systems over heroics—and the whole is greater than the sum of its parts.


Core Values:

  • Integrity
  • Growth Minded
  • In Service to Others
  • Provide Solutions
Onboarding & Support


There is currently no formal onboarding program—this will be part of the early partnership. You'll collaboratively identify the tools and support structures needed to achieve great outcomes. This is an opportunity to help shape the operational foundation from the ground up.


Application Process


Please send the following to (operations+ ) :

  • Resume: As a PDF titled (Lastname.Firstname.ExecutiveAssistant.pdf)
  • Cover Letter addressing:
  • How you meet the required skills and experience
  • Specific examples of systems or SOPs you've built
  • Your experience with AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity, automation tools)
  • A time you anticipated a leader's needs and proactively solved a problem
  • How you've closed loops and driven projects to completion
  • Why you're interested in supporting multiple ventures simultaneously
  • AI Competency Example: Share a specific example of how you've used AI tools to automate a workflow, solve a problem, or improve efficiency
  • Email Subject: Systems Over Heroics

Timeline: We aim to fill this position within 2–3 weeks.

Well-structured and thoughtful applications demonstrating critical thinking and systems-first approach will stand out. If you have questions about the role, feel free to include them in your message.

title: English Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities: text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts).
  • Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety.
  • Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses.
  • Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs.
  • Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team.
  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.
  • Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity.
  • Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above); additional languages a plus.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently.
  • Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs.
  • Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI/ML domains.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus.

While moderation of high-harm/high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility.


What We Offer:

  • Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems.
  • Innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements.
  • Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation.

Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Sinch is looking for a talented and experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team. In this crucial role, you will be responsible for building, maintaining, and supporting data pipelines that connect our various products globally. You will use innovative approaches and technologies, designing data architectures that empower the data domain and provide actionable insights that support key decisions across the organization.

Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement robust, scalable data pipelines that ensure data accuracy and availability across multiple platforms.
  • Work on the data integration of various Sinch platforms and products worldwide.
  • Contribute to data pipelines development, performance, quality, monitoring, and maintenance.
  • Optimize existing data workflows and databases for performance and scalability, using best practices and cutting-edge tools.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement in our products, business, and architecture through the strategic use of data.
  • Lead data engineering projects , serving as a technical reference and providing guidance to team members (e.g., through code reviews).

  • Advocate for Data Engineering best practices both inside and outside the team.
  • Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends to contribute innovative ideas to our data strategy.


Must Have

  • Consistent experience as a Data Engineer or in a related role.
  • Strong knowledge of software development (e.g., Python , Spark, Git, CI/CD, Docker).
  • Expertise in SQL to query data and build ETL/ELT processes.
  • Proficiency in designing modern data pipelines and architectures.
  • Experience working with Data Lake and Data Warehouse concepts, using best practices to structure and store big volumes of data.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and optimize data pipelines for performance and reliability.
  • Experience in data pipeline creation/orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow , Dagster ).

title: Pessoa Analista de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas Sênior Full-Stack
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história:

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.

Falando da área:

Trabalhar na área de Engenharia da Neoway mantém o colaborador conectado com a inovação, ao constante aprimoramento por melhores metodologias de desenvolvimento e a novas tecnologias para atender os objetivos estratégicos e de negócios da Neoway.

Utilizamos metodologias ágeis por princípio e focamos no ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos usuários. O time de Engenharia é responsável por construir, evoluir e sustentar todo o ecossistema que compõem nossa plataforma de Big Data Analytics, chamada Plataforma Neoway.


Acreditamos que um software de qualidade é fácil de usar, funciona corretamente, é de fácil manutenção/sustentação, fácil integração e mantém a integridade para evitar possíveis falhas, fora ou não, do controle de quem o desenvolveu.


Para alcançar este objetivo atuamos em dois pilares distintos para garantir a eficiência do processo de desenvolvimento de software assegurando a qualidade junto a um ambiente saudável na área de Engenharia, no aspecto de boas práticas e cultura de desenvolvimento:


1° - Pessoas é um pilar estratégico para Neoway, atuamos de maneira pró ativa em conjunto com todas as áreas da empresa, garantindo o desenvolvimento de talentos, crescimento profissional e formação do nosso DNA, impulsionando a cultura de times de alta performance (liberdade com responsabilidade).


2° - Técnico (Paved Way), acreditamos que ferramental e a automação ajudam a dimensionar a capacidade de um time, mas nenhuma ferramenta resolverá todos os problemas na produtividade no desenvolvimento ou nas operações. A ideia é ter um conjunto de ferramentas e práticas de “paved way” que são formalmente suportadas por algumas pessoas. Não exigimos a adoção desses “paved way” , mas incentivamos a adoção, garantindo que o desenvolvimento e as operações usando essas tecnologias sejam uma experiência muito melhor do que não usá-las.


Falando do time:

O foco do time é contribuir para a evolução estratégica da Plataforma Neoway, fornecendo às Unidades de Negócio da empresa uma série de sistemas, ferramentas e padrões que apoiam e promovem a autonomia dos demais times de desenvolvimento a acelerar suas entregas e criação de novos produtos.

Missão do cargo:

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software você fará parte de um dos times de desenvolvimento e será responsável por agregar conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo ou construindo parte das soluções de nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, buscando soluções para situações do dia a dia, visando sempre o trabalho harmônico em equipe, a qualidade do código e da arquitetura em geral.


Como será o seu dia a dia no time:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas, fomentando práticas de Code Review e desenvolvimento orientado a testes (TDD/BDD);
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura, escalabilidade e segurança dos nossos produtos;
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços;
  • Criar soluções resilientes, escaláveis e de alta performance;
  • Garantir desenvolvimento seguro, observando atualizações de segurança e critérios relevantes;
  • Atuar como referência técnica no time, apoiando colegas menos experientes e disseminando boas práticas.


Para assumir estas responsabilidades você precisa ter as seguintes habilidades:

  • Compreensão de arquiteturas distribuídas e de alto volume de dados (repositórios, filas, microsserviços, etc);
  • Domínio de conceitos e boas práticas de engenharia de software (da concepção à entrega, sustentação e operação, TDD, documentação, code review, etc);
  • Experiência em Go ou Node.js, com abertura para aprender outras stacks;
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc);
  • Experiência com infraestrutura em Cloud (preferencialmente GCP);
  • Conhecimentos em APIs Rest, Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Programação concorrente e escalável;
  • Conhecimento em processos de versionamento e práticas de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com observabilidade (monitoramento, logging, tracing, métricas);
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração em equipe;
  • Capacidade de encarar mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com erros;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento e atuar como mentor(a);
  • Promover nossa cultura e valores.


Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Conhecimento dos conceitos de Big Data, Data Lake, Metadados com perspectiva de governança de dados;
  • Experiência com front-end moderno (Vue.js, Angular, React);
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura como código (Terraform, Ansible);
  • Conhecimento em serviços de mensageria (PubSub, SNS, Kafka);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise e busca (BigQuery, ElasticSearch).

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:
SOBRE A LETS


A LETS é uma empresa de tecnologia que atua na integração de canais de venda com operadores logísticos, potencializando resultados de negócios por meio de soluções inovadoras. Nosso sistema SaaS, chamado Max, é a espinha dorsal que conecta varejistas, operadores logísticos e canais de venda de forma eficiente e automatizada, oferecendo uma experiência simplificada e eficaz para todos os envolvidos. Nossa missão é desenvolver soluções tecnológicas inovadoras que maximizem o desempenho e a eficiência dos negócios, capacitando empresas a alcançar resultados excepcionais.


Estamos crescendo rapidamente e buscamos talentos que queiram fazer parte de nossa jornada, ajudando a transformar o ecossistema de tecnologia e logística para negócios. Se você é uma pessoa com conhecimentos em vendas e na plataforma do HubSpot , apaixonada por resultados, métricas e empresas em pleno crescimento a LET'S é o seu lugar!


SOBRE A VAGA


Estamos em busca de um(a) SDR — Sales Development Representative para impulsionar a geração de demanda e criação de pipeline comercial em contas B2B (médio e enterprise). Você será responsável por prospecção outbound, qualificação de leads inbound, agendamento de reuniões qualificadas (SQLs) e pelo handoff fluido para o time de Vendas (AEs) .


No dia a dia, usará HubSpot (Sales/Marketing Hub) para rodar cadências multicanal (e-mail, ligação, WhatsApp/LinkedIn), segmentar listas, personalizar abordagens por ICP/persona e operar um processo data-driven com SLAs de resposta (lead response time) , taxas de conversão e show rate sob acompanhamento constante. Trabalhará em sintonia com Marketing (ABM, campanhas e conteúdo) e com Vendas (territórios, critérios de passagem, feedbacks de qualidade).


ATIVIDADES


  • Inbound: atender leads rapidamente (SLA de minutos ), qualificar (BANT/CHAMP/MEDDICC-lite), registrar contexto e agendar reunião com AE.
  • Outbound: construir listas por ICP/persona, pesquisa de conta/decisores , rodar cadências no HubSpot (e-mail, call, WhatsApp/LinkedIn), personalizando mensagens e hipóteses de dor/valor.
  • ABM & personalização: trabalhar contas-alvo junto do Marketing (páginas ABM/Webflow, conteúdos e ofertas), adaptando pitch por segmento (varejo, last-mile, marketplaces B2B).
  • Qualificação & handoff: aplicar critérios claros de passagem (fit, timing, dor, potencial), registrar notas/objetivos próximos passos e garantir handoff sem fricção.
  • Métricas & rotina: controlar LRT, taxa de resposta, reuniões marcadas, show rate, SQLs , pipeline criado e conversões por etapa/canal; sugerir testes de assunto, templates e cadências.
  • CRM disciplina: manter HubSpot atualizado (propriedades, atividades, próximos passos), gerir tasks, listas e sequences com organização exemplar.
  • Feedback de mercado: coletar sinais (objeções, concorrentes, requisitos), produzir insights para Vendas, Marketing e Produto; fechar o loop com aprendizados.
  • Compliance & boas práticas: seguir políticas de opt-in/opt-out, LGPD , UTMs e qualidade de dados em todas as interações.


REQUISITOS


  • Experiência comprovada (2+ anos) como SDR/BDR em SaaS B2B ou soluções complexas (ciclo consultivo).
  • Domínio de HubSpot (Sales Hub) no dia a dia (lists, sequences, tasks, deals, snippets, playbooks, relatórios básicos).
  • Prospecção outbound e qualificação inbound aplicando BANT ou CHAMP (ou equivalente) e perguntas consultivas (SPIN) ; cadências multicanal no HubSpot (e-mail, ligação, WhatsApp/LinkedIn) com disciplina de CRM.
  • Escrita clara e persuasiva (frio → quente), comunicação verbal confiante para ligações.
  • Organização e disciplina de CRM (registro de atividades, follow-ups, prazos).
  • Foco em metas (reuniões/SQLs/pipeline criado) e melhoria contínua via dados.
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura de materiais, e-mails e benchmarks.
  • Diferencial forte (não eliminatório): certificações HubSpot (Sales Software/Inbound) ou trilhas concluídas na HubSpot Academy/LinkedIn Learning.


HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS


  • Vivência em empesas de software (SaaS) ; logística/last-mile, varejo ou marketplaces B2B .
  • Experiência com LinkedIn Sales Navigator , ferramentas de prospecção (Apollo/Lusha/Hunter) e WhatsApp Business integrado ao HubSpot.
  • MEDDICC-lite/Challenger , ABM com mapeamento de decisores/buying committee, Sales Navigator , testes A/B de cadências/assuntos e co-criação de playbooks com AEs/Marketing.
  • Noções de ABM (contas-alvo, buying committee, mensagens por persona).
  • Integrações e automações com n8n ; familiaridade com Webflow ↔ HubSpot .
  • Espanhol básico é um plus.


BENEFÍCIOS


  • Remuneração competitiva + participação nos resultados.
  • Comissão direta sobre as vendas.
  • Plano de saúde (incluindo cônjuge e filhos).
  • Plano odontológico.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • Cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Rotina com ferramentas modernas e IA ; aprendizado contínuo.
  • 100% remoto (trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil).


DETALHES:


  • Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) .
  • Jornada: tempo integral, com eventuais rituais/treinamentos.
  • Local: remoto – fuso BRT (GMT-3) .
  • Todas as vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD).
  • Em nossos processos seletivos, não há qualquer tipo de distinção em virtude de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, crença, condição social, etnia ou raça .
  • Como se destacar: envie links das certificações HubSpot , cases mensuráveis (ex.: ganho de conversão, redução de LRT, melhora de deliverability), prints/redashboards e uma breve descrição de arquiteturas de objetos/pipelines que você implementou e; faça os cursos dentro da HubSpot Academy ou no próprio LinkedIn comprovando seus conhecimentos.

title: Pessoa Especialista de Responsabilidade Social
description:
A ENGIE Serviços de Operação e Manutenção é responsável por operar e manter os gasodutos da TAG, empresa adquirida pelo grupo em 2020. Com a aquisição da TAG, a ENGIE é detentora da mais extensa malha de transporte de gás natural do país com 4.500 km que atravessam 10 estados e 191 municípios.



Missão


Atuar na gestão de projetos sociais nas comunidades de influência da ENGIE, com foco nas áreas de interface dos ativos de gás natural. Garantir alinhamento às diretrizes corporativas, aos requisitos legais e aos compromissos socioambientais. Conduzir a análise, avaliação e acompanhamento de iniciativas sociais, principalmente as vinculadas a incentivos fiscais, além de consolidar e reportar informações para relatórios de sustentabilidade.




Principais Responsabilidades


  • Identificar e avaliar projetos sociais em comunidades nas áreas de atuação da ENGIE, priorizando as interfaces com os ativos de gás;

  • Atuar em interface direta com as áreas de Relações com Públicos de Interesse (RPI) e Meio Ambiente, especialmente nas comunicações relacionadas aos licenciamentos ambientais;
  • Conduzir e acompanhar todo o ciclo de projetos incentivados (nos seus diversos mecanismos), incluindo inscrição, análise pela comissão, due diligence, aporte junto à controladoria e prestação de contas;
  • Elaborar e reportar informações relacionadas a investimentos e resultados sociais para o relatório de sustentabilidade da empresa;
  • Monitorar e reportar indicadores de desempenho social, promovendo melhoria contínua e fortalecendo a imagem institucional;
  • Estabelecer relacionamento com stakeholders locais, órgãos públicos, associações e entidades proponentes, assegurando transparência e legitimidade no processo.




Requisitos


  • Formação superior (áreas desejáveis: Ciências Sociais, Serviço Social ou Engenharia Ambiental);
  • Experiência/Vivência com projetos sociais e legislação de incentivos fiscais;
  • Conhecimento em due diligence e prestação de contas de projetos sociais;
  • Gestão de equipes matriciais;

  • Desejável Experiência com relatórios de sustentabilidade e conhecimento de indicadores sociais.

description:

title: Data Analyst (Sales Focus)
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.


Why You Should Apply NOW:

  • The Data Feeds team manages the data feeds business at YipitData. We partner with systematic and quantamental investment firms by providing access to alternative data for investment analytics and model development.
  • Become part of a growing team where your ideas and collaboration will have a direct impact on how we deliver value to top-tier investment firms.


About The Role:

YipitData seeks a proactive, analytically minded Sales Engineer with +2 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role will directly influence the growth of our data feed revenue. As a Sales Engineer, you will provide our clients with operational and quantitative development support , enabling them to utilize and evaluate YipitData’s data feeds effectively.


We expect East Coast work hours.


As Our Sales Engineer, You Will:

  • Provide operational support during client onboarding, with a strong focus on the setup, configuration, and integration of complex data feeds (40% daily focus).
  • Partner closely with Sales to drive product adoption by delivering demonstrations, analyses, and explanations of complex data feeds to clients.
  • Address client queries and maintain strong relationships by ensuring our data solutions align closely with clients’ investment strategies.
  • Develop quantitative documentation, scripts, and use-case examples to facilitate client evaluations, integrations, and ongoing data usage (60% daily focus).
  • Collaborate with Product to improve product features based on client feedback.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline or finance-related field.
  • Experience in financial markets (Nice to have) ; excellent client-facing communication skills.
  • Experience working with US clients is highly preferred
  • Proficiency in Python (preferred), SQL, Databricks (preferred), Jupyter, and AWS (Knowledge focused on answering clients’ questions).


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Chief Executive Officer
description:
Hartmann Young is proud to be partnered with a leading dietary supplement manufacturer serving both domestic and international markets across South America. The company is recognised for its strong scientific foundation, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and commitment to innovation in nutritional products. With a diversified customer base spanning consumer health, functional foods, and nutraceutical brands, the business is poised for a new phase of strategic growth and international expansion.


As Chief Executive Officer , you will lead the company’s strategic, operational, and commercial direction across South America. You will be responsible for driving profitability, operational excellence, and long-term growth, ensuring the business continues to innovate and compete at the forefront of the dietary supplement manufacturing industry.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define and implement the company’s strategic vision and long-term business objectives across Brazil, Chile, Argentina, and other key South American markets.
  • Oversee all business operations, including manufacturing, R&D, sales, quality, and regulatory functions.

  • Work closely with the board and investors to deliver sustainable financial and market performance.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Life Sciences, Engineering, or related field (MBA preferred).

  • Deep understanding of supplement manufacturing processes, regulatory frameworks, and supply chain dynamics.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen with experience leading P&L responsibility.
  • Bilingual or multilingual (Portuguese, Spanish, and English proficiency highly desirable).
  • Dynamic leadership style with a focus on innovation, growth, and organizational excellence.

title: Sustaining Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

    • Vivência em implementação de boas práticas de segurança em backend (como proteção de APIs, criptografia de dados sensíveis, gestão de certificados)
    • Experiência com processamento de grande volume de dados, analytics ou machine learning (diferencial que alinha com os projetos de IA da aquarela)

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software .Net Sênior
description:
Qual o tamanho dos seus objetivos? Deseja novos desafios?


Então, vem para TQI!


A TQI é uma empresa de tecnologia e inovação que há mais de 30 anos, desenvolve soluções para suportar e alavancar os negócios de seus clientes no Brasil e no exterior.

Com escritórios em Uberlândia (MG) e em São Paulo (SP), e colaboradores em centenas de cidades, a TQI conquistou e mantém há mais de 6 anos o selo Great Place to Work (GPTW), e está no ranking 80+ do GPTW de Tecnologia, reforçando seu compromisso para promover um ambiente diverso e propício para inovação e alta performance.

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

O que você precisa ter:


  • Experiência sólida e comprovada em desenvolvimento backend com .NET 8 , incluindo liderança técnica em projetos complexos.
  • Profunda vivência em arquitetura de microsserviços e arquitetura hexagonal , com atuação em desenho de soluções escaláveis e resilientes.
  • Conhecimento avançado em autenticação e autorização (JWT, OAuth2, OpenID Connect) .
  • Experiência na construção, consumo e versionamento de APIs REST , seguindo boas práticas de segurança e padronização.
  • Atuação consistente com testes unitários, de integração e de performance , promovendo cultura de qualidade no time.
  • Forte experiência com mensageria (RabbitMQ e/ou Kafka) em cenários de alta volumetria e processamento distribuído.
  • Uso avançado de Redis para cache, filas e otimização de performance.
  • Experiência robusta com banco de dados Oracle e boas práticas de modelagem, tunning e queries complexas.
  • Vivência aprofundada em DevOps e CI/CD , com participação ativa na definição e evolução de esteiras de integração e entrega contínua.
  • Experiência sólida com AWS (EKS, ECS, Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB, S3, entre outros) , avaliando trade-offs arquiteturais.
  • Domínio em monitoramento, observabilidade e análise de performance (Kibana, Dynatrace, New Relic, Grafana, CloudWatch).
  • Conhecimentos em Angular e React para apoiar integrações front-back (mesmo sem foco em frontend).
  • Capacidade de mentorar e apoiar desenvolvedores mais juniores e plenos , contribuindo com revisões de código, disseminação de boas práticas e decisões técnicas.


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Graduação em Sistemas da Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-Graduação ou MBA desejável (Arquitetura de Software, Cloud Computing ou áreas correlatas).


O que você vai fazer:


  • Liderar o desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações backend em .NET 8, garantindo alta performance, qualidade e escalabilidade.
  • Contribuir ativamente no planejamento, priorização e execução de sprints , apoiando o time e trazendo clareza técnica para as entregas.
  • Definir, construir e evoluir pipelines DevOps , assegurando boas práticas de automação e entrega contínua.
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes críticos de produção, propondo melhorias estruturais a partir de observabilidade e métricas de performance .
  • Atuar de forma integrada com times de produto, QA e frontend, assegurando entregas consistentes, escaláveis e seguras.
  • Guiar decisões técnicas, promover revisões de código e modelar soluções arquiteturais , sempre com foco em escalabilidade e boas práticas.
  • Mentorar o time em conceitos avançados de engenharia de software, disseminando conhecimento e fortalecendo a cultura técnica.


O que oferecemos:


Você fará parte de equipes diversas e de alto performance, em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo. Valorizamos a contribuição de todos na criação de soluções e nas decisões estratégicas. Aqui, as pessoas são o nosso diferencial, e somos apaixonados por tecnologia, inovação e evolução contínua.

Todas as nossas vagas estão disponíveis para pessoas com deficiência!


O time está te esperando, vamos nessa?


#VempraTQI

Visão: Ser referência global de qualidade em soluções de TI.

title: Regional Workforce Administration Manager
description:
Regional Workforce Administration Manager

Employment Type: Full Time Location: Brazil

Remote

Job Summary

Iron Mountain is seeking an experienced, strategic Regional Workforce Administration Manager to join our Workforce Administration (WFA) team. This person needs to be familiar with I-9 (Employment eligibility verification) and US Workforce processes asides from local Workforce Administration.

The ideal candidate must be strong in deploying inhouse strategies regarding employee files, benefit administration among others.

You will be leading and optimizing the delivery of retained Workforce Administration services across a multi-country region, ensuring compliance, data accuracy, and a high-quality employee experience.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Lead a regional team of 4 to 10 Workforce Administration professionals, providing coaching, managing performance, and fostering continuous professional development.
  • Oversee all retained WFA services and, for regions outside of North America (NAM), manage Benefits Administration to ensure processes are properly documented, executed, and compliant with all local government regulations.
  • Drive continuous service delivery improvement by identifying opportunities, implementing solutions to enhance efficiency and accuracy, and collaborating with regional leaders on transformative projects (e.g., migrating administration work from other HR teams).

What You'll Bring

The ideal candidate will have:

  • 7+ years of proven experience in HR operations, HR Shared Services, or Workforce Administration, with a strong focus on a multi-country or international environment.
  • 2+ years of experience in people management, including leading, coaching, and managing the performance of direct reports.
  • In-depth knowledge of HR compliance requirements, employee data reporting, and Benefits Administration principles across Latam and North America.
  • Full professional proficiency in English and Spanish , along with demonstrated experience using HRIS systems like Workday and case management tools like ServiceNow (although others similar are ok)

What We Offer (Benefits)

  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • Flexible work options/alternative work options to support work-life balance.
  • Comprehensive health, wellness, and retirement plans.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth.

If you are a proven HR leader with deep expertise in workforce administration and a passion for driving operational excellence across diverse regions, apply to join Iron Mountain and lead our team today!

title: Senior Technical Recruiter
description:
Senior Technical Recruiter


About the Role:

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Technical Recruiter to join our dynamic team and play a pivotal role in driving our growth. As a key member of our Talent Acquisition team, you will be responsible for sourcing, screening, and closing top-tier tech talent across the Americas. You will be instrumental in understanding the intricacies of the US tech market, building strong relationships with candidates and clients, and meeting aggressive hiring targets, including sourcing at least one qualified candidate per open position.

Requirement:

  • Talent Acquisition:
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet aggressive deadlines.
  • Source, screen, and assess technical candidates across various technology domains, including software engineering, data science, cloud computing, and cybersecurity.
  • Develop and execute effective sourcing strategies, leveraging various channels like job boards, social media, and professional networks.
  • Conduct basic technical screening to evaluate candidates' skills and cultural fit when needed.
  • Negotiate competitive compensation packages and close deals efficiently.
  • Proven track record of successfully recruiting technical talent, particularly in the US market.
  • Strong understanding of the US tech industry, including emerging technologies and trends.
  • Team Leadership:
  • Manage and mentor a team of 2-3 technical recruiters.
  • Foster a positive and collaborative team culture.
  • Provide guidance and support to team members to enhance their recruitment skills.
  • Process Improvement:
  • Implement innovative recruitment tools and technologies to streamline the hiring process. Proficiency in using Custom recruitment tools and technologies (e.g., ATS, CRM, LinkedIn Recruiter).
  • Analyze recruitment metrics and identify areas for improvement.
  • Drive continuous process optimization and efficiency gains.
  • Stakeholder Management:
  • Build strong relationships with hiring managers and business leaders to understand their hiring needs.
  • Provide regular updates on recruitment progress and proactively address any challenges.
  • Collaborate with the CTO to align recruitment strategies with overall business objectives.
  • Reporting and Analytics:
  • Prepare detailed daily reports on recruitment activities, bottlenecks, and performance metrics.
  • Take ownership of recruitment failures and propose effective remediation strategies.
  • Leverage data-driven insights to optimize recruitment efforts.


Other Details

  • Location: Remote role 
  • Length: 2+ years, long term
  • Open to W2 full-time with benefits or C2C
  • Rate: DOE
